name: Delivery Mystery
storyline: You play as a delivery man in a really really normal city of Deskadia. It's not your first day as a delivery man, but this time, expect something different. An old man that is a friend of yours, crazy asphalt man, a normal man, and a girl with really normal appearance. What can possibly go wrong? Can you choose your character's destiny?
summary: You play as a delivery man in a really really normal city of Deskadia.
